LocalConvert: PDF and image tools for the command line.

Pages are numbered from 1. Ranges: "1-3,5,8-".
If -o/--output is not given, editing commands write "<name>_modifie.pdf".

  images2pdf <output.pdf> <image...> [--size A4|A3|A5|Letter|Legal|fit] [--orientation auto|portrait|landscape]
                                     [--margin <mm>] [--no-enlarge]
  merge      <output.pdf> <file.pdf|image...>
  delete     <input.pdf> <pages>               [-o output.pdf]
  extract    <input.pdf> <pages>               [-o output.pdf]
  reorder    <input.pdf> <order>               [-o output.pdf]   e.g. order "3,1,2" or "5-1"
  move       <input.pdf> <from> <to>           [-o output.pdf]
  insert     <input.pdf> <position> <file...>  [-o output.pdf] inserts before page <position>
  rotate     <input.pdf> <pages> <90|180|270|-90> [-o output.pdf]
  split      <input.pdf> <folder> [--every N | --ranges "1-3,4-7,8-"]   (default: one page per file)
  compress   <input.pdf> <output.pdf> [--level light|medium|strong]
  pdf2img    <input.pdf> <folder> [--format png|jpg|bmp|gif|tiff|webp] [--dpi 150] [--pages 1-3] [--quality 90]
  pdf2doc    <folder> <file.pdf|image...> [--format docx|odt|txt] [--no-ocr]
             text and paragraphs; scans and images are read by OCR
  convert    <folder> <image...> --format png|jpg|bmp|gif|tiff|webp|avif [--quality 90] [--max-width px] [--max-height px]
  video      <folder> <video...> --format mp4|mkv|webm|avi|ogg|mov|gif [--quality high|medium|low]
             [--max-height 720] [--no-audio] [--copy] [--start 1:30] [--end 2:45]   (needs FFmpeg in the PATH)
  frames     <folder> <video...> [--format png|jpg] [--fps 1] [--start 0:10] [--end 0:20] [--quality 90]
             [--max-height 720]   extracts the frames (all by default) into <folder>/<name>_images
  audio      <folder> <audio|video...> --format mp3|wav|aiff|flac|ogg|opus|m4a [--quality high|medium|low]
             [--rate 44100] [--channels 1|2] [--start 0:30] [--end 1:00]   (needs FFmpeg in the PATH)
  info       <input.pdf>

Les réponses aux questions qu'on se pose: Answers to the most common questions.
Mes fichiers sont-ils envoyés quelque pa: Are my files sent anywhere? No. Everything is done on your computer, even OCR. Only the FFmpeg download (once, on Windows) uses the Internet.
Qu'est-ce que FFmpeg ? Un logiciel libre: What is FFmpeg? Free software that converts videos and audio. On Windows, LocalConvert offers to download it at the first conversion (about 200 MB, only once). On macOS and Linux, install it with brew or apt.
Une conversion échoue ? Le message d'err: A conversion fails? The error message is shown and the details are saved in LocalConvert's "logs" folder, in your account's data (on Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\LocalConvert\logs).
Peut-on automatiser les conversions ? Ou: Can conversions be automated? Yes: the command-line program localconvert-cli, shipped with the app, does the same conversions (run it without arguments to see the list of commands).
Où trouver la dernière version ? Sur la: Where can I find the latest version? On the project's GitHub page, under "Releases" (link in "About").
Toutes les conversions se font sur ton o: All conversions happen on your computer: no file is sent online, no account is needed.
